name: mcpAudio
description: Builds an audio MCP content block. data is a base64-encoded string of the audio bytes and mimeType is the audio's MIME type (e.g. "audio/mpeg"). The block passes through the automatic result coercion untouched, so use it when a tool wants exact control over what the client renders. An omitted mimeType is left out rather than written as null.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: The MIME type of the audio, e.g. "audio/mpeg".

links.title: RustCFML MCP documentation
links.description: Content helpers for exact control over MCP responses.

examples.title: Return an audio content block
examples.description: A tool can return an explicit audio block alongside a text block.
